en: Black‑and‑white view of a small alpine village in a wide valley, with scattered houses and chalets along a rural road in the foreground. Steep, forested mountains rise immediately behind the settlement, and in the distance a massive, almost vertical rock plateau typical of the Dolomites dominates the skyline. Coniferous trees fill most of the slopes, and open meadows surround the buildings. There is no visible printed caption or text on the front.
